transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a supply-chain finance facility on the table today -- $6,000,000 in supplier invoices from our approved purchasing division. The preliminary proposal assumes 90% financing of eligible invoices, with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I can make a decision on whether this facility may launch and on what operating terms, I need to conduct our standard round-robin review. I'd like to start with credit risk: please walk us through your assessment of the supplier recourse structure and any concentration or default concerns you see. Legal, I'll need your read on the recourse framework and any documentation issues. And finance operations, please give me your view on feasibility of administering this at 90% advance rates without special controls. Let's go in that order.
